item: Ovarian stroma: inner cortex vs medulla
what_to_research: The atlas label says medulla, the ROI says 82-91% outer cortex, and the dominant subatlas label is Stroma_InnCor (inner cortex) with Stroma_Medulla only 7% on the larger set. Three sources, three stories. Decide what these cells are before any CL term is attached.
papers_to_read: OvarySanger2026 (NO DOI  -  in-house, ask the atlas team)
action: DO NOT adopt CL:0002134 (part_of ovarian medulla). CL:0002133 stromal cell of ovarian cortex is the better fit on current evidence. Resolve with the ovary team.

what_to_research: Proposed CL:1000022 is mesonephric NEPHRON TUBULE epithelial cell, but 100% of the Wolffian Epi subatlas label lands here  -  Wolffian (mesonephric) DUCT epithelium is a different structure from a nephron tubule. Establish which it is.
action: Hold CL:1000022. If it is duct rather than tubule, CL has no term and this becomes a new-term request instead.

what_to_research: Location ruled out cumulus. The dominant subatlas label is Granulosa_AMH_early (72%), which names a follicle stage rather than a mural/cumulus position, so the cuboidal fallback is a guess at the grain rather than a reading of the evidence.
papers_to_read: OvarySanger2026 (NO DOI  -  in-house, ask the atlas team)
action: Confirm whether these are early-growing-follicle granulosa (cuboidal, CL:4033084) or something CL cannot yet express.
